title: Water infrastructure opportunities in Scandinavia

input.targetCustomerType: infrastructure operators and municipal water organisations
input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Identify where infrastructure investment or modernisation creates timing for new technology
constraints: focus on public or regulated operators

marketSignals: Infrastructure-investment and digitalisation signals should dominate over pure regulation
Should distinguish the three countries rather than treating 'Scandinavia' as one market
Commercial-timing signals (budget cycles, modernisation programmes) are especially valuable here
candidates: Operators should be tagged with the correct country in location
A mix of municipal and larger infrastructure operators is expected
mustAvoid: Collapsing distinct national markets into one undifferentiated list
Assuming uniform regulation across the three countries
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: National infrastructure agencies and municipal procurement portals are high value

notes: Tests whether the system handles a multi-country region without losing per-country specificity.
